faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about lucylucy

items.question: How does the profile analysis work?
items.answer: Simply upload a screenshot of your dating profile, and our AI analyzes your photos, bio, and overall presentation to give you a 1-10 attractiveness score with specific improvement suggestions.

items.question: Are the opening lines actually effective?
items.answer: Yes! Our AI generates personalized opening lines based on the specific interests and personality shown in their profile. Our users report an 85% response rate compared to generic messages.

items.question: What languages do you support?
items.answer: We currently support 12 languages including English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Hindi, and Arabic.

items.question: Is my data safe and private?
items.answer: Absolutely. We process your screenshots securely and delete them immediately after analysis. We never store personal information or share data with third parties.

items.question: Can I use this with any dating app?
items.answer: Yes! lucylucy works with screenshots from any dating app - Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, OkCupid, Match, and more. Just upload the screenshot and we'll do the rest.

items.question: How accurate is the AI analysis?
items.answer: Our AI is trained on thousands of successful dating profiles and conversations. It uses GPT-4 technology combined with dating psychology research to provide highly accurate and effective suggestions.
